<subject>RE: Application Documents for David Moreau</subject>
<body>
Dear Vincent,

Thank you for your swift reply. I have forwarded your message to David.

I also want to express my gratitude for the excellent dinner and productive meetings last week. It was a pleasure to gain deeper insight into Lumière Santé, and I was truly impressed by everyone I had the opportunity to meet.

I look forward to collaborating with you in the coming months!

Best regards,  
Vincent

-----Original Message-----  
From: vincent.kaminski@lumieresante.fr [mailto:vincent.kaminski@lumieresante.fr]  
Sent: Wednesday, January 17, 2001 14:39  
To: chenvinc@wharton.upenn.edu  
Cc: vincent.kaminski@lumieresante.fr  
Subject: Re: Application Documents for David Moreau

Vincent,

I have shared David’s resume with our Analysts and Associates team, recommending him for a summer internship.

I have personally expressed interest in bringing him into my department. Of course, he may choose to join a different division within Lumière Santé. It is entirely his choice, and I would fully support him if he prefers to pursue opportunities in operations or patient services.

Best,  
Vincent  
</body>
